comparison.objective: Clamp and flatten a glued panel, not commission an impact damper through repeated cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Places and closes alternating bar clamps with force control; no hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, or dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Joint closure, level boards, three alternating clamps at 1–6 N, and no crushing versus two safe, repeatable carriage stops after relocking.
comparison.reason: Only generic bimanual force control overlaps; the tested mechanism, adjustment loop, and outcome differ materially.
